text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I decided to go observe the 
racetrack. While many Horse Girls waited 
on the course—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was one Horse Girl whose sharp gaze 
stood out distinctively. That was... 
Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She, who looked more starved for victory 
than anyone else—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surged with momentum from the middle of 
the race, blasting past everyone to claim 
a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-sama~~! Your run today was so 
utterly wonderful~!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, don't make such a fuss. It wasn't 
that big of a race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounding Sirius Symboli were numerous 
reporters and entourage members, 
overflowing with words of celebration. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! That was a victory won 
with such comfortable ease!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
As expected, the name 'Symboli' isn't just 
for show! Will you be reporting this 
delightful result to your childhood 
friend, Symboli Rudolf-san as well?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you're dying to hear about 
the "Emperor", huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then rather than wasting time here, why 
don't you go tell her directly yourself?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh? No... that's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reporter tried to smooth things over, 
but unable to endure Sirius Symboli's 
intimidating presence, they promptly left 
the scene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Emperor", Symboli Rudolf. Hearing 
that name seemed to change her demeanor, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys, what's with those glum 
faces? The victory party's already set up, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yes, of course! Let's celebrate in 
grand style!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and also—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What's your business? Staring at me like 
that, you must have something you wanna 
say, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though bewildered by the situation and 
being called out so suddenly, I knew 
exactly what words to say.
choice_data_list: You're just as skilled as the rumors say.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, a natural outcome. So—what're you 
gonna do for me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're congratulating me, aren't you? 
Specifically, what are you gonna do for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already gave my congratulatory words. 
What on earth else was I supposed to 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
choice_data_list:
(—I have no idea what the right answer 
is!!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Kuku, hahaha! Don't look so lost over just 
this!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, that look on your face will do for 
today. ...I'll be expecting something next 
time we meet, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was I being toyed with... perhaps? In any 
case, Sirius Symboli walked away looking 
thoroughly amused.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, 'as skilled as the rumors say'? Not 
bad. But... that's still not enough.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not 'just like the rumors', but 'beyond 
the rumors'. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I need to teach you some proper 
manners. For instance, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Turn your ear towards me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without understanding why, I leaned my ear 
towards her for the time being. Then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
S-Suddenly, she touched my ear...!! And 
lightly bent it over...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That's a horse girl-style 
'greeting'.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Greetings are important. ...Make sure to 
practice so you can do it yourself next 
time, alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was that just now...? From that 
first-time experience, my heart wouldn't 
stop pounding for a while...
